description:
During the day, she's a librarian at the Ark's biggest library.
At night, she's a phantom thief who punishes evil in the name of justice.
Though she believes she keeps her nightly activities well hidden, most of the people who should know of it already do.

costumes.name: Saint Thief
costumes.description:
Phantom costume.
Obtained from the Costume Gacha.

lines.text: Did you call? Despite my appearance, I'm in fact working as a librarian.
If you receive a note from me, I hope it inspires you have a moment of introspection.

I'm practicing writing some warning notes.
... Don't you think I'm cool?

I came here to steal your heart,
but it's my heart that has been spirited away...

I became a thief to return that which has been stolen back to the rightful owner.
In that sense, you and I have a lot in common.

A thief is always captivated by all things beautiful.
Perhaps that is why I find you so mesmerizing.
You're leaving in front of me? Ha. Don't blame me if something goes missing.
Don't worry. Your heart is the only thing here that I intend to abscond with.

If you come to the library, I could recommend many good books.
For example... The Phantom's Tears?
Tell me if you see anyone up to no good.

The Outpost is rife with narrow alleyways winding between these buildings.
It's the perfect place for a thief.
Tonight, I shall spirit away your precious heart.
I should be able to move more stealthily now.
Thank you. I'll put these skills to good use for you.
This is good. I just so happen to have somewhere I need to be today.
You gave me something so precious... Thank you.
You didn't steal this from somewhere, did you? Haha, just joking.
I won't lose this. I'll take good care of it.
I want to stroll under the night sky with you.
So, this is how it feels to have your heart stolen.
Tonight, instead of a warning note, I shall write you a love letter.
I'm on your side.
Did you call?
Heading over there now.
This is where my warning note leads.
I will punish all wrongdoers.
I'll have this all taken care of before sunrise.
There are so many things to steal!
Reloading.
There's still plenty here to steal.
I'm waiting for nightfall.
It's time.
Phantom will come for you when night falls.
The darkness will cover us.
I've stolen everything here.
Where next?
There's nothing else to take.
Urgh!
I've been caught...!
Ow!
I'm sorry... I'll come back tomorrow night...
As usual, the thief comes out victorious.
I've no intention of neglecting my regular duties just because I'm now a Thief of Judgment.
I'm thinking of writing an autobiography that could double as a guide to being a phantom thief. Will you help me?

About this outfit... It's meant to represent the awakening of a phantom thief who, after fighting for justice her whole life, joins forces with her allies at the last minute and... Hey, are you listening?
The road to justice has no end. I would be glad if you walked it with me.
It makes me proud to see that you have also grown as a phantom thief.
You don't have to worry about my feelings for you changing. I may be a Thief of Judgment now, but my true self hasn't changed.
The Thieves of Judgment... Heheh... I really nailed the name if I do say so myself...
Hmm. I suppose both justice and phantom thieves need time to rest. I'll stay by your side, so enjoy your break.
Hehe... People can't take their eyes off me. It's not ideal for a phantom thief, but it's perfect for a paragon of justice.
The Outpost is a peaceful place. I'm sure it's all thanks to you, Monsieur.
I'm thinking about recruiting some new phantom thieves. What do you think?
Phantom the Saint Thief has arrived to judge the wicked! ... And I don't mean their choice of fashion.
I've become even more just!
This sacred power will aid me in judging the wicked.
I promise to use this power for the greater good.
I shall repay you handsomely.
Even a phantom thief would have trouble acquiring this. I'll treasure it.
Thank you. This brings me joy.
Our bond grows deeper.
Our hearts have become one.
I want to continue walking this path with you.
I'm ready.
I'm listening.
Will do.
In the name of justice, you will not go unpunished!
I've already left them my calling card.
Time to judge this rampant evil!
Prepare to be impressed!
Reloading!
This is not over yet.
Evil knows no end.
It's time.
Forgive me, for I use no gimmick or trick.
The hour of judgment is upon you!
In the name of justice!
Accept your judgment!
Pretty impressive, right? Hehe.
Ugh...
Ridiculous!
Urgh!
Ugh... Justice... cannot be defeated...!
Hehe. Justice always prevails.

favorite.name: Precious Masks
favorite.description:
No matter what mask you wear or what form you take, you remain the same. 
What matters is that there are now more people who see you for who you truly are beneath the mask.
